metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire detections than Thailand between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Active Fire detections FeatureCollection (MODIS/061/MCD14DL) and filter by date (2016-08-01 to 2018-03-01) and by the union of Cambodia and Thailand boundaries (USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017). Count detections per country.
2. Masking strategy: Not applicable (point detections dataset; no cloud masking required).
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: Check collection size; if 0, attempt fallback (unlikely needed). If counts are null/undefined/non-finite -> C3. Otherwise compare counts; equal counts => B (not more).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2016-08-01';
    const end = '2018-03-01'; // exclusive
    const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017');
    const cambodiaGeom = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Cambodia')).geometry();
    const thailandGeom = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Thailand')).geometry();
    const studyGeom = cambodiaGeom.union(thailandGeom, 1);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let datasetId = 'MODIS/061/MCD14DL';
    let fires = ee.FeatureCollection(datasetId)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(studyGeom);

    let totalSize = await fires.size().getInfo();
    if (totalSize === 0) {
      // Fallback attempt (unlikely needed)
      datasetId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGTDL_NRT';
      fires = ee.FeatureCollection(datasetId)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(studyGeom);
      totalSize = await fires.size().getInfo();
      if (totalSize === 0) {
        console.log(`Dataset tried: ${datasetId}`);
        console.log('Period: 2016-08-01 to 2018-02-28');
        console.log('No fire detections found in region and period.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing: counts per country
    const camCount = await fires.filterBounds(cambodiaGeom).size().getInfo();
    const thaCount = await fires.filterBounds(thailandGeom).size().getInfo();

    // 4. Validation
    const validCam = Number.isFinite(camCount);
    const validTha = Number.isFinite(thaCount);
    const validTotal = Number.isFinite(totalSize);
    if (!validCam || !validTha || !validTotal) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetId}`);
      console.log('Period: 2016-08-01 to 2018-02-28');
      console.log(`Total detections (both): ${totalSize}`);
      console.log(`Cambodia detections: ${camCount}`);
      console.log(`Thailand detections: ${thaCount}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Evidence & Final Answer
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetId}`);
    console.log('Period: 2016-08-01 to 2018-02-28');
    console.log(`Total detections (both): ${totalSize}`);
    console.log(`Cambodia detections: ${camCount}`);
    console.log(`Thailand detections: ${thaCount}`);

    // A if Cambodia > Thailand, else B
    const answer = camCount > thaCount ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
